target.name: Gerald
target.detail: still on hold to the boiler people

setup: Older bloke, tan coat, phone in the back pocket like an invitation. Arguing with someone about a boiler that's been broken three weeks.
on_success: Two streets away before he notices. He'll blame the boiler people.
on_fail: His hand closes on your wrist. He doesn't shout — he just looks at you, disappointed, like a teacher. Worse than shouting.
on_crit: Wallet and phone. There's a photo of a dog in the wallet. You leave the photo on a bus seat where someone'll hand it in.

setup: A lad in a suit a size too big, CV in a plastic wallet, mouthing answers at the bus stop. Phone face-up on his knee. He's early.
on_success: Gone before his bus comes. He'll be halfway through telling them he's reliable before he notices.
on_fail: He grabs your wrist, the CV goes everywhere, and he's apologising to you while he picks pages off the wet pavement.
on_crit: Phone and a folded twenty — his lunch. The CV says he volunteers at a food bank Saturdays.

setup: Girl filming herself walking, talking to a camera on a stick, spare phone held loose behind her for the 'candid' angle.
on_success: You're a blur in the corner of someone's Story. Fourteen viewers. None of them you.
on_fail: She spins, still filming, and now you're content. 'Guys. GUYS. Did you see that.' You did not sign a release.
on_crit: Two phones — hers and the spare. The live keeps streaming from your pocket for a while.

setup: Bloke asleep against the window on the last train, hi-vis still on, phone loose in a lap rising and falling slow. Empty carriage.
on_success: You lift it clean and he doesn't stir. His alarm's set for 5:40. It'll ring in an empty seat.
on_fail: His hand closes over yours without his eyes opening. 'Not tonight, mate.' Too tired to be angry. He just holds on.
on_crit: Phone and a lanyard — agency work. You take the phone. You leave the lanyard where he'll find it.

target.detail: a paper map, in this year

setup: Couple with an actual paper map, turning it the wrong way up. Bag unzipped six inches. Either brave or a trap.
on_success: They ask you for directions right after. You give them good ones. Least you can do.
on_fail: The 'lost tourist' has very fast hands and a very calm voice. Off-duty something. You leave with nothing but a warning.
on_crit: Phone, cash, and a little camera. The camera's full of the two of them, grinning, everywhere but here.

setup: City boy, three pints deep at four in the afternoon, telling the phone he's 'basically running the desk now.'
on_success: He won't notice till the card machine says no. He'll assume it's the bank's fault. It always is, for him.
on_fail: Turns out four pints makes some men slow and some men loud. This one's loud. Very.
on_crit: Phone and a money clip — actual metal. Who has a money clip. He does. Did.

setup: Buggy, shopping bags, phone balanced on the handle, one hand on a toddler pointing at everything.
on_success: You take the phone. The kid watches you do it and waves. You do not wave back.
on_fail: The toddler says 'that man' very clearly and the dad turns round very fast. You're already not there.
on_crit: Phone and the loose cash in the buggy pocket. You feel this one in your chest most of the way home.

setup: Headphones, armband, phone strapped on, running the same loop of the park he runs every day.
on_success: He runs the rest of the loop before he understands. You could hear the playlist skip.
on_fail: Turns out a man who runs 10k can also catch you over 40 metres. Who knew. He knew.
on_crit: The whole armband comes with it. There's a house key tucked in the back. You post it through his door two streets on.

setup: Bus stop, six people, everyone staring the same direction willing the bus to come. Easy. Also six witnesses.
on_success: The bus comes. Everyone gets on. One of them a phone lighter. Nobody looks at anybody.
on_fail: The old dear at the front misses nothing. 'OI.' The whole queue turns as one. You go.
on_crit: You time it with the bus doors. Phone and a purse, gone in the shuffle of everyone boarding at once.

setup: Someone's friend, propped against a wall, being slowly left behind by his group. Somebody's robbing him tonight.
on_success: Might as well be you. Might as well not be. You decide it's you. That's the job.
on_fail: He's more awake than he's letting on. 'The fuck?' — and his mates are closer than they looked.
on_crit: Phone, watch, and a taxi already booked on the app. You cancel the taxi. Small mercy, big walk for him.
